claims.sentence: The purpose of this study is to determine whether simple, evidence-based clinical screening be quickly and feasibly implemented (\>85% of patients in an average of \<6 minutes) in large-volume urgent transient ischemic attack (TIA)/stroke clinics to identify individuals at high risk for the three most common and devastating post-stroke co-morbidities (depression, obstructive sleep apnea and cognitive disorders).
